scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix mobile install && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix mobile run lint && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix mobile test && cd backend && uv run pytest
